headline: Take-Two gets hammered on GTA 6 jitters while Labor's CGT-linked tax cuts dominate Aussie politics — markets steady overall but rain's coming to the GC.

portfolio.summary: Take-Two is the standout loser, down 4.4% as GTA 6 anxiety lingers. Alphabet slipped 1.2% despite solid recent earnings — likely some profit-taking. Emerging markets ETF (VGE) was the bright spot, up 1.2%. The rest of the portfolio was largely flat.

movers.name: Take-Two Interactive
movers.note: Dropped sharply — GTA 6 concerns about scope and cost creep dominate headlines. No hard catalyst but sentiment is wobbly.

movers.name: Alphabet Inc. (Google)
movers.note: Mild pullback despite positive recent earnings backdrop. New Gemini Omni announcement could be a catalyst to watch.

movers.name: Vanguard FTSE Emerging Markets ETF
movers.note: Solid gain — rising AUD and easing global risk sentiment supporting EM assets.

movers.name: Vanguard US Total Market Shares ETF
movers.note: Steady lift tracking a broadly positive US session.

movers.name: Vanguard Diversified High Growth ETF
movers.note: Modest gain, consistent with broad market tone.

movers.name: Commonwealth Bank of Australia
movers.note: Small dip — RBA rate hike uncertainty and bond market repricing applying light pressure on bank valuations.

markets.summary: All three major indices edged higher. S&P 500 up 0.37%, ASX 200 up 0.40%, NASDAQ up 0.19%. Gold flat, crude oil unchanged at $96.60. The AUD pushed up to 0.7174, a 0.35% gain — partly driven by unwinding of RBA rate hike bets rather than domestic strength.

indicators.name: ASX 200
indicators.note: Solid session, tracking global risk-on mood.

indicators.name: AUD/USD
indicators.note: Rising despite softening RBA hike expectations — worth watching.

indicators.name: Crude Oil (WTI)
indicators.note: Flat — US-Iran deal hopes capping upside despite supply tightness.

politics.summary: The big domestic story is Labor floating a package that ties popular income tax cuts to CGT and negative gearing reforms — a politically loaded move that could reshape property investment calculus. Separately, RBA rate expectations are shifting fast, with bond markets repricing and the AUD diverging from rate differentials.

stories.title: Labor to tie tax cuts to CGT and negative gearing changes
stories.why_it_matters: This is a major policy signal. If Labor bundles income tax cuts with CGT and negative gearing changes, it forces a political and financial reckoning for property investors. Direct relevance to anyone holding property or planning asset strategy.

stories.title: RBA rate rise bets and government debt fears unwind, lifting demand for Australian bonds
stories.why_it_matters: Bond markets are repricing RBA rate expectations downward. This is relevant to CBA and broader financials — lower rate expectations can compress bank margins but also support growth valuations.

stories.title: Why is the Australian Dollar rising despite weakening RBA rate hike odds?
stories.why_it_matters: AUD rising while rate hike bets fall is unusual — suggests capital inflows or commodity support driving it. Worth understanding if you're holding USD-denominated assets like GOOGL, MSFT, and TTWO, as a stronger AUD erodes returns when converted back.

stories.title: Temporary fall in inflation won't ease RBA fears
stories.why_it_matters: Even with a short-term dip in inflation, the RBA is unlikely to cut rates in a hurry. Steady rates keep pressure on mortgage holders and consumer spending — headwind for domestic retail and bank credit growth.

ai.summary: The dominant AI story today is actually from the Vatican — Pope Leo XIV has issued his first encyclical explicitly calling for robust AI regulation, citing risks in finance, warfare, and human dignity. Meanwhile, Google quietly dropped a significant product announcement: Gemini Omni.

stories.title: Introducing Gemini Omni
stories.why_it_matters: Google just launched Gemini Omni — a major multimodal AI model. This matters directly for your GOOGL position. It's a signal that Alphabet is pushing hard to compete with OpenAI and Anthropic, and recent earnings already showed AI revenue momentum.

stories.title: Pope Leo XIV calls for robust regulation of AI — warns some weapons now beyond human control
stories.why_it_matters: The Pope's encyclical is the most high-profile moral voice yet calling for AI regulation. While not binding, it adds significant political pressure on governments — especially in Europe — to accelerate regulatory frameworks. Medium-term risk for AI companies facing compliance costs.

stories.title: Pope Leo Warns of AI Risks, Calls for Oversight in Finance & War
stories.why_it_matters: The specific callout of AI in financial markets is worth noting. Autonomous trading and AI-driven financial products are already mainstream — regulatory pushback in this space could affect fintech and quant-heavy funds.

sport.summary: AFL dominates today with the sad passing of Neale Daniher at 65 — a genuine legend and the face of Fight MND for over a decade. NRL is gearing up for Round 13 with key injury clouds over Origin stars and Warriors/Tigers. A World Surf League event in NZ was put on hold after a photographer was bitten by what may have been a shark.

stories.title: Neale Daniher, football legend and Fight MND campaigner, dies aged 65
stories.why_it_matters: One of the most beloved figures in Australian sport has passed. Daniher's 13-year battle with MND was fought publicly and inspired a movement. The AFL and wider sporting community will be in mourning this week.

stories.title: NRL round 13 predicted teams: Mystery surrounds Origin stars; Tigers, Warriors cop major injury blows
stories.why_it_matters: Origin selections are muddying team lists ahead of Round 13. Tigers and Warriors fans bracing for more pain with fresh injury concerns.

stories.title: World Surf League event in NZ put on hold after Australian photographer bitten by 'shark or a sea lion'
stories.why_it_matters: WSL event suspended in NZ after a scary incident. Given the Gold Coast surfing community, this is worth knowing — conditions can change fast and events getting called off is always disruptive for competitors and spectators.

stories.title: AFL Round 12: Team news, fixtures, games, tips, odds — everything you need to know
stories.why_it_matters: Full Round 12 wrap and Round 13 preview — useful for the weekend's games.

watch_today.title: TTWO down 4.4% — monitor for further weakness
watch_today.detail: Take-Two's drop is driven by sentiment around GTA 6's cost and scope rather than hard news. If further negative commentary emerges this week, there's downside risk. No need to act today unless your position sizing concerns you.

watch_today.title: Labor's CGT + negative gearing package
watch_today.detail: Labor is tying income tax cuts to CGT and negative gearing reforms. If this gains traction, it's a material shift for property investors and could affect bank sentiment (CBA). Watch for Albanese government confirmation or denial this week.

watch_today.title: Google's Gemini Omni launch is a tailwind for GOOGL
watch_today.detail: A major new multimodal AI product launch from Alphabet. Combined with strong recent earnings, this is a positive signal for the GOOGL position. No action needed but good context for holding.

watch_today.title: AUD rising despite falling RBA rate hike expectations
watch_today.detail: Your USD-denominated holdings (GOOGL, MSFT, TTWO) generate lower AUD returns when the dollar strengthens. AUD at 0.7174 and climbing — worth keeping in mind when assessing portfolio performance in local currency.
